newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Yields fall on 28-day Lithuanian T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields fall on 28-day Lithuanian T-bills.

text.p: Yields fell on 28-day Lithuanian Treasury bills at Monday's auction and all of the 30 million litas issue was sold as it was oversubscribed, the country's central bank said.
The average yield was 7.87 percent, down from the 8.46 percent offered at the last auction for 28-day paper on April 22. The settlement date is June 5 and the bills mature on July 3.
All amounts in millions of litas unless otherwise specified.
